planning.assumed: Qualitative duration TIME01 required; numerical readout and s introduced. No clockface or speed skill required.
coTaught: Numeral readout explicitly modelled; optional3+3 transfer not an addition mastery claim.
planning.scope: Short-event duration in standard seconds; optional mention longer units, no conversion/clockface proficiency.
planning.evidenceLimits: Low-stakes own-clock reading and agreed-unit reasoning, not physical technique/independence/retention. No stored personal evidence.
planning.curriculumVsDesign: Frozen OPH reference inherited; story, controls, cadence and model parameters are project design, not curriculum-prescribed.
planning.assetProvenance: Original SVG/state renderer; supplied Loikka raster unchanged; licence/release holds retained.

extensions.timingSemantics: Playback1:1 approximate walltime; explicitstep1modelsecond without wait. No autoplay. Each clock begins on own event, stops at event end. Whole second display floors, pauses freeze both.

entryPilot.design: Early live exploration and optional native anchor navigation; compact presentation chrome only on these two pages. Retained full explanations, case/answer semantics, constructive placement or event-clock/rhythm meaning, canonical title and all teacher functions.
entryPilot.learningBenefit: Unmeasured design hypothesis; no human/learner validation.
